noticeEn:
The Launch Event is here! (11/18 - 12/31)
- Earn points from daily and event missions for 20 reward tiers
- 34 mage summons + the final reward: the 'Festive Apprentice' Christmas skin (+2% all damage just by owning it)
- Open [Benefits] > 'Launch Event'

New in 1.0.9
- New features unlock one per stage (some unlock stages changed)
- Support mage star abilities (★2/4/6/8/10)
- Stage Select, Grimoire [Fusion] tab
- Duration cards +15% damage, stronger lightning
